definitionZh: CSS 正当项目属性定义了框中所有项目的默认正当性,并赋予它们按照适当的轴对每个框进行解释的默认方式。
sourceDefinition: The CSS justify-items property defines the default justify-self for all items of the box, giving them all a default way of justifying each box along the appropriate axis.
